## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Naples, Italy. It starts at 16 Via Nuovo Macello.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Welcome to a one-of-a-kind experience that will transport you into the fascinating world of marine life. Turtle Point center boasts over 600 square meters of indoor space and 7,000 square meters of outdoor space, equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories for environmental and biological analyses.
>
> It also boasts an outpatient clinic with surgical and radiological rooms, an extensive educational exhibition, a multimedia room, and spaces dedicated to the care and rehabilitation of marine turtles injured by human activity that impact coastal and marine environments.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €7.87. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 10 ratings and 8 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
